full_title: British Virgin Islands - Level 1: Exercise Normal Precautions
content_md:
Exercise normal precaution

in the **British Virgin Islands**.

British Virgin Islands is generally a safe destination for travelers.

  * British Virgin Islands regularly experiences hurricanes. 
  * Review our information on [W _eather and Natural Disasters_](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/british-virgin-islands.html#weather "Weather and Natural Disasters") in British Virgin Islands.
  * Review our _[Travel Guidance for British Virgin Islands](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/british-virgin-islands.html#requirements "Travel Guidance")_ to learn how to prepare for a safe trip.
